description: Get the public profile of one retailer (shop) on authorized.by. Read-only. Returns address, contact details, opening hours, categories, subscription plan, TÜV certification, customer rating, registration date, seal_implemented (whether the authorized.by seal is live on their shop), and certificate_url / certificate_url_de: links to the retailer's public authorized.by certificate page (English / German) listing all brands that authorized it. These links are null when the retailer has no active authorization. Data scope: results only cover relationships registered and confirmed on authorized.by. An empty result or a not-found error does NOT prove that no authorization exists outside authorized.by. Distinguish outcomes: an empty list means no matching record on authorized.by; an error result whose text starts with 'Brand not found' or 'Retailer not found' means the given id/alias is unknown; an error result whose text starts with 'Tool execution failed' is a technical error and says nothing about the data.

id_or_alias.description: Retailer numeric ID, slug or alias.

name: get_retailer

outputSchema.description: The public profile of one retailer.

brand_count.description: Number of brands that currently authorize this retailer on authorized.by.

certificate_url.description: Public authorized.by certificate page (English) that proves the authorization; null when there is no active authorization.

certificate_url_de.description: Same certificate page in German; null when there is no active authorization.

description.description: Description text in German (de) and English (en); each may be null.

opening_hours.description: Weekly opening hours of the physical store; empty or null when unknown.

payment_methods.description: Accepted payment methods; null when unknown.

registration_date.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) the company registered on authorized.by.

social.description: Social media profile URLs; each may be null.

trustami.description: Customer rating from Trustami; fields are null when no rating exists.

profile_url.description: URL of the rating profile, or null.

review_count.description: Number of customer reviews, or null.

tuv_certification_date.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) the TÜV certification was granted; null when not certified.

id.description: Numeric authorized.by ID. Accepted by the id_or_alias argument of the detail tools.

plan.description: authorized.by subscription plan of the retailer: PREMIUM, START or FREE.

seal_implemented.description: Whether the authorized.by seal is live on the retailer's shop.

slug.description: URL-safe identifier. Accepted by the id_or_alias argument of the detail tools.

tuv_certified.description: Whether the retailer holds a TÜV certification via authorized.by.

title: Get retailer profile
